hero.label: Inventory Control System
hero.headline: Inventory, measured to
hero.sub: Real-time stock, a built-in POS, and role-based control in one system. Close the month in minutes — with zero guesswork about what you hold.

features.label: Features
features.title: Six systems. One source of truth.
features.intro: Stock, sales, procurement, and people — run from one platform that updates the instant anything moves. No spreadsheets to reconcile, no tabs to keep in sync.

items.title: Real-time stock tracking
items.desc: Every sale, transfer, and return updates counts the instant it happens. Low-stock thresholds fire before you run out — not after an angry customer tells you.

items.title: Role-based access
items.desc: Admin, Manager, and Staff each see exactly their remit and nothing else. Permissions are scoped per role and enforced on every route, not just hidden in the UI.

items.title: Built-in point of sale
items.desc: Scan, charge, print. Cash, card, bank transfer, Easypaisa or JazzCash — and stock deducts itself the moment the sale closes.

items.title: Sales & analytics
items.desc: Revenue, best-sellers, and profit on live charts. Pull a clean, formatted spreadsheet for any date range in a single click.

items.title: Suppliers & orders
items.desc: Track who supplies what, raise purchase orders, and reconcile stock-in against deliveries — the whole procurement loop on one screen.

items.title: Full activity log
items.desc: Who changed what, when, and from which IP. Every action is timestamped and attributed, so nothing on the system happens off the record.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.title: Live in an afternoon. Not a quarter.
workflow.intro: There is no six-week onboarding. Load your catalog, start selling, and read your numbers the same day — three moves, in order.

steps.title: Set up your catalog
steps.desc: Import products, categories, and suppliers in bulk, or add them as you go. Barcodes optional. You have a working store the same afternoon — not next quarter.

steps.title: Run the day
steps.desc: Sell on the POS, move stock between shelves, raise purchase orders. The whole team works in one place while counts stay exact, automatically.

steps.title: Read the signals
steps.desc: Watch revenue, margins, and low-stock in real time. Export the exact numbers your accountant asks for, on demand — no manual tallying.

system.label: System
system.title: Built like infrastructure,
system.intro: The parts that keep your data correct and your team accountable — engineered in, not bolted on.
specs: JWT in HTTP-only cookies, role-guarded on every route.
Socket.IO pushes stock, orders, and alerts to every open session.
MongoDB with a local-storage fallback for offline counters.
Formatted .xlsx reports for sales, inventory, and audit — any range.
Full audit trail, IP-attributed, immutable once written.

items.a: A single system for product businesses: real-time stock, a built-in POS, analytics, supplier and order management, multi-role access, and a full audit log — no add-ons required.
Three, each with scoped permissions: Admin (full system), Manager (inventory, reports, suppliers), and Staff (POS and daily operations). Roles are enforced server-side, not just hidden.

items.q: Does it include a point of sale?
items.a: Yes. The POS handles barcode scanning, five payment methods (cash, card, bank transfer, Easypaisa, JazzCash), receipts, and automatic stock deduction on checkout.
A local-storage mode keeps the counters working offline. The default mode uses a cloud database with real-time Socket.IO updates across sessions.
Yes — sign up and use every feature with no card and no artificial limits during the trial.

cta.title: Start counting
cta.sub: Create an account and load your first products in minutes. No card, no limits during the trial.

footer.tagline: One precise system for stock, sales, and suppliers. Built by Eiretech for product businesses that can't afford to guess.
